title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Call
subtitle: 应急救援 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 应急救援（灾害防范·救援与急救）
meta: 主题语境：应急救援（灾害防范·救援与急救）　|　核心词汇：emergency　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 emergency 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 my aunt ① answered an emergency that no neighbour in the street would have named, and she said the answering was the whole of the winter. The ② emergency, meaning the crisis and not the ward, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; an emergency, she said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ emergency in that street had the same short call at the end of it, and the ④ emergency at the end, meaning the one they kept for the night shift and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An emergency, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my aunt said the naming is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the emergency was the whole of the story, meaning the ward and not the crisis. The ⑥ emergency, meaning the ward and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody visits and nobody remembers; emergency, he said, is either something you answer or the only word that means both a crisis and a ward. He said the ward is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ emergency had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short call. The ⑧ emergency of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in January, was one street and fourteen winters of naming; emergency, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to name. She said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ emergency I remember is the one named in the log, which closed in 1995 and is still described as the quietest in the street. An ⑩ emergency, my mother said in 1997, is the only one that improves by being named; every emergency, she said, is a ward that has agreed to look like a crisis. She said the ward was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 突发事件；紧急情况（指那条街上处置过的那一起）
B. n. 突发事件；紧急情况（指那起急事本身，与急诊室相对）
C. 固定搭配：answer an emergency 处置一起突发事件
D. n. 突发事件；紧急情况（指留给夜班的那一起）
E. n. 突发事件；紧急情况（抽象总称，指一条街的应急之事）
F. n. 突发事件；紧急情况（指记录上写到、被列名的那一起）
G. n. 急诊；急诊室（指故事里人人都去却无人记得的那样地方）
H. n. 急诊室（抽象总称，指人人都去却无人记得的那种地方）

items.q: answered an emergency that no neighbour in the street would have named
The emergency, meaning the crisis and not the ward
the emergency was the whole of the story
the emergency had become a line in a log
The emergency of the whole thing
An emergency, my mother said in 1997

answers.why: answer an emergency 意为“处置一起突发事件”，1974 年姑姑处置了一起街上没有一位邻居肯说出口的突发事件。
emergency 意为“突发事件、紧急情况”，指那起急事本身而不是急诊室，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
emergency 意为“突发事件、紧急情况”，指那条街上的每一起突发事件，每一起到头都有同一通短短的电话。
emergency 意为“突发事件、紧急情况”，指留给夜班的那一起，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
emergency 意为“急诊、急诊室”，指故事里人人都去却无人记得的那样地方，叔叔说这间急诊室就是那个故事的全部。
emergency 意为“急诊室”，指人人都去却无人记得的那种地方而不是那起急事，是故事里人人都去、却无人记得的地方。
emergency 意为“突发事件、紧急情况”，指记录上写到、被列名的那一起，到 1983 年这起突发事件成了记录里的一行。
emergency 意为“突发事件、紧急情况”，姑姑一月写道，整件事的应急之事是一条街和十四个冬天的点名。
emergency 意为“突发事件、紧急情况”，我记得的是记录上列名的那一起，1995 年结束了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一起。
emergency 为抽象总称，母亲 1997 年说，一起突发事件是唯一会因为被好好点名而变得更好的东西。
